verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents launching or managing multiple autonomous agents in parallel, or running them unattended for hours or days. Running non-interactively in scripts is only a building block a user could orchestrate themselves, and checkpointing saves and resumes a single session rather than supporting long-running fleets. One community comment mentions a 'subagent system', but it is unclear which product it describes and it is not first-party documentation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days
